atoms.title: UHC Health Matters news and articles
atoms.question: What is UHC Health Matters?
atoms.text: UHC Health Matters is UnitedHealthcare's news and articles hub. It offers the latest news and articles on topics that support a person's health journey, from healthy living to understanding Medicare benefits to health insurance tips and more.
questions: Where does UnitedHealthcare publish health and insurance articles?

atoms.title: News and article categories
atoms.question: What categories of articles does UnitedHealthcare publish?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare news and articles hub is organized into five categories: Benefits & coverage, Community, Healthy living, Medicare and Newsroom.

atoms.title: Special Needs Initiative growth since 2017
atoms.question: How big has UnitedHealthcare's Special Needs Initiative become?
atoms.text: In a featured employee video, a UnitedHealthcare employee says the Special Needs Initiative has grown immensely since it started in 2017. It began with one family advisor connecting with 10 families. Now each year it brings in more than 30,000 new families and connects them to one of over 400 family advisors working on a team.
questions: How many families does UnitedHealthcare's Special Needs Initiative serve?
How many family advisors does the Special Needs Initiative have?

atoms.title: How a family advisor supported one family
atoms.question: What does a Special Needs Initiative family advisor do?
atoms.text: In the featured video, a UnitedHealthcare employee whose daughter has special needs says his Special Needs Initiative family advisor connected all the dots for his family. The advisor helped them start a new journey of dealing with the aftermath of his daughter's illness and the newness of being a dad with a child with special needs.

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare employee stories
atoms.question: Where can I read stories from UnitedHealthcare employees?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare features employee stories on its news and articles hub. The stories introduce employees whose work is helping people live healthier lives and are collected on a page titled Meet the people behind UnitedHealthcare.
